title: I think I was kicked out of mall world
content: I started my dreams about mall world a few years ago and I’d go there almost every night. The dreams were more frequent within the last few years. However, I was having these dreams with no knowledge of “mall world”. I thought they were just dreams about a fancy mall with a bunch of quirks. I learned it was a thing for other people last week and now I don’t have dreams about it. Probably because my subconscious won’t let me, but still. Has this happened to anyone else? If it actually is a liminal space…
